note: Documented shape (chat audit 2026-09-17, C3): a user turn's metadata.files carries the documents it was sent with — the web's ChatMessage renders them as chips on reopen. Two spellings are in use: bare names and {name,size,type} objects.

body.content: Review the attached lease and the rent schedule for the Westlands premises.

The lease runs for six years from 1 March 2026 at a monthly rent of KES 180,000, reviewed upward by 10% every two years. The rent schedule matches the lease for the first two years but shows KES 205,000 from March 2028, which exceeds the 10% cap.
